# Atd

> Atd (anything, anytime, anywhere, to do) is a free, open-source macOS AI desktop agent (MIT licensed). A native app for macOS 15 or later (Apple silicon or Intel) opens a floating panel on ⌘ ⇧ Space anywhere to run coding, computer use, MCP/skill workflows, screenshot and screen-recording captures, and automation with cloud or local models.

## Core Pages

- [Website (English)](https://atd.best/): product overview, workflow showcase, capabilities, and installers
- [Website (简体中文)](https://atd.best/zh): product overview and installers in Simplified Chinese
- [Blog & Release Notes (English)](https://atd.best/blog): release notes, newest first ([RSS feed](https://atd.best/feed.xml))
- [博客与更新日志 (简体中文)](https://atd.best/zh/blog): release notes in Simplified Chinese ([RSS feed](https://atd.best/zh/feed.xml))
- [Frequently asked questions about Atd](https://atd.best/faq): Answers about Atd, the free, open-source AI agent for macOS: supported Macs, installing and updating, models and cost, data storage and permissions. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/faq))
- [Full LLM Reference](https://atd.best/llms-full.txt): generated full product, capability, FAQ, and release notes reference in production builds

## Features

- [Everything Atd can do on your Mac](https://atd.best/features): What Atd does on your Mac: computer use, screenshots and recording, a selection toolbar, cloud or local models, MCP and skills, automations and apps. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features))
- [Computer use](https://atd.best/features/computer-use): Atd works in Mac apps and websites for a task, only where you approve, and stops when you say so. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/computer-use))
- [Screen capture](https://atd.best/features/screen-capture): Annotated screenshots, scrolling long screenshots and screen recordings you can ask Atd about. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/screen-capture))
- [Selection toolbar](https://atd.best/features/selection-toolbar): Select text in another app to ask Atd or run a saved command, then choose where the answer goes. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/selection-toolbar))
- [Models](https://atd.best/features/models): Use your own models: ChatGPT plan sign-in, API keys, cloud services, or local and custom endpoints. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/models))
- [MCP and skills](https://atd.best/features/mcp-and-skills): Connect MCP servers, add skills and subagents, and save commands you can run from anywhere on your Mac. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/mcp-and-skills))
- [Automations](https://atd.best/features/automations): Run prompts and saved commands on a schedule, when files change, when your Mac is idle or after another automation. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/automations))
- [Personal apps](https://atd.best/features/apps): Describe a small tool and Atd builds it as an app with its own window, backend and desktop widgets. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/apps))
- [Privacy and control](https://atd.best/features/privacy): Local storage, keychain credentials, no Atd account, and approval controls you set for every task. ([中文](https://atd.best/zh/features/privacy))

## Downloads & Source

- [Download for Apple silicon](https://downloads.atd.best/latest/Atd-arm64.dmg): newest stable installer for Apple silicon (macOS 15 or later); saves as `Atd-<version>-arm64.dmg`
- [Download for Intel](https://downloads.atd.best/latest/Atd-x64.dmg): newest stable installer for Intel Macs (macOS 15 or later); saves as `Atd-<version>-x64.dmg`
- Preview builds for [Apple silicon](https://downloads.atd.best/rc/Atd-arm64.dmg) and [Intel](https://downloads.atd.best/rc/Atd-x64.dmg): newest release candidate when newer than stable
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/JUNERDD/Atd): the native macOS shell, React UI, and local agent service
- [Releases](https://github.com/JUNERDD/Atd/releases): release notes and dmg installers per version
